description:
Location: US
Department: Sales

The Role

StarCompliance is looking for an experienced Senior Sales Executive to join our sales team and drive new business growth within a defined territory.

This is an opportunity for an accomplished enterprise sales professional who understands the complexities of selling technology into regulated financial institutions. You’ll take ownership of the full new-logo sales cycle, building and developing a strong pipeline and working with multiple stakeholders to turn complex business and compliance challenges into compelling solutions.

You’ll combine strong commercial instincts with a consultative, solution-led approach, collaborating across the business to create an efficient sales process and deliver sustainable revenue growth.

What You’ll Do

• Own and manage a defined new-logo sales territory, with responsibility for achieving and exceeding sales targets.

• Build, grow and execute a high-quality pipeline using the full range of tools and resources available to you.

• Lead complex enterprise sales opportunities from initial engagement through to close.

• Develop a strong understanding of the compliance and regulatory challenges facing financial services organisations and translate these into relevant solutions.

• Build detailed technical and practical knowledge of the StarCompliance platform and its capabilities.

• Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes involving Compliance, Legal, Risk, IT, Procurement and other key decision-makers.

• Work collaboratively with colleagues across StarCompliance to maintain an efficient, high-velocity sales process.

• Maintain excellent standards of CRM data management, forecasting and deal hygiene.

• Knowledge of Salesforce, SalesNav, and AI Tools

What We’re Looking For

You’ll be an experienced enterprise sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business in complex environments.

Ideally, you’ll bring:

• At least 5 years’ experience in a quota-carrying sales role .

• A demonstrable track record of achieving and growing against sales targets.

• Experience selling complex enterprise solutions into regulated financial institutions.

• Experience of SaaS sales and an understanding of SaaS industry standards and sales approaches.

• Familiarity with compliance-led buying cycles influenced by regulatory pressure, risk mitigation and audit requirements.

• Experience managing long, complex sales cycles and navigating budget scrutiny.

• Confidence working with multiple stakeholders and decision-makers across functions including Compliance, Legal, Risk, IT and Procurement.

• A consultative, solution-led approach rather than a transactional sales style.

• Knowledge of established sales methodologies and playbooks.

Why StarCompliance ?

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, financial services and compliance, helping organisations address increasingly complex regulatory challenges.

You’ll join a collaborative sales environment where you’ll have ownership of your territory, the opportunity to develop deep expertise in the StarCompliance platform, and the tools and resources to build and execute a successful enterprise sales pipeline.

At StarCompliance , we expect every colleague to operate with a high standard of personal integrity and to carry out their responsibilities ethically.

Interested in joining us? Apply today and help us shape the future of compliance technology.

We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part-time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA
“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP
“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

• Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Board certification (required)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

• Able to cover the following primary locations: Seattle/ King County

description:
PLEASE NOTE: TO APPLY TO THIS POSITION, please send your resume to HR(AT)SIMONHEGELE.COM

Position Summary and Objectives:

The Field Installation Team Coordinator is responsible for developing and optimizing weekly installation schedules that maximize workforce efficiency and ensure customer commitments are met. This role acts as the central workforce planning hub for the medical equipment installations teams and the objective is to align installer availability, qualifications and locations with customer installation timelines to maximize daily field productivity.

Essential Position Functions:

• Develop, optimize, and publish weekly work schedules for all field installation teams.

• Analyze and verify installer availability, qualifications, and geographic location to optimize weekly job completion rates.

• Assign installation teams based on OEM certifications and geographic location.

• Optimize travel and route efficiency where practical.

• Balance installers travel across multiple states or regions.

• Coordinate installation timing with equipment delivery, rigging, and site readiness.

• Assign crew vehicles and other resources.

• Independently monitor schedule changes, and update stakeholders.

• Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts, coverage gaps, last-minute changes, and rebalance schedules.

• Communicate work assignment details, schedule updates, and project changes to the operations administrative team.

• Contact installation teams to dispatch and confirm work assignments.

• Serve as primary planning contact for installation team scheduling and communicate current updates.

• Escalate scheduling conflicts and resource shortages without delay.

• Handle basic resource planning such as rental car reservations, cancellations, and communication to the installation teams.

• Resolve schedule overlapping, installer absences, and urgent customer re-scheduling requests without delay.

• Update the internal dispatch system with accurate job status and relevant notes.

• Embrace company values and work with other team members to accomplish company goals.

• Maintain highest level of confidentiality of all company, personnel, and business interaction matters.

• Compliance with applicable business processes and all quality and EHS plans.

• May be required to perform other duties as necessary.

Competency Requirements:

• Minimum 2-3 years in field dispatch, logistics coordination, workforce planning, or other relevant experiences.

• Proficiency with dispatch platforms or other workforce management tools and software.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, evaluate, and display data.

• Geographic planning, workload balancing, and workforce utilization experience.

• Proficiency in Excel, data visualization tools, ERPs, and other operational systems.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for managing remote workforce schedules.

• Ability to make quick, logical decisions under tight time constraints.

• Strong multi-tasking skills with extreme attention to logistical details.

• Precision work with a strong ability to maintain attention to details.

• Stress tolerance and adaptability to a fast-paced environment.

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to communicate effectively with a diverse group of team members, leadership, and other entities.

Standard office equipment (i.e. computer, laptop, smartphone, telephone, copy machine, printer) and other general office equipment and materials.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
About Frontier
Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints . Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that - and called it Frontier .
At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. About Bundle
Bundle delivers live 1:1 leadership and manager training with expert instructors. No micro-lessons, no click-through tutorials, just real conversations that build skills people actually use. We work with enterprise and mid-market companies across manufacturing, healthcare, construction, and beyond, and we’ve hit our goals six quarters in a row. Now we’re building toward where performance management meets live leadership development.
Role Overview
We're hiring a Full-Time Instructional Designer to help us craft, refine, and scale the materials that power our training sessions. You will work closely with our core learning design team to apply sound adult learning practices and ensure every deck, plan, and resource meets Bundle's high standards for quality, engagement, and consistency.
This is a remote, hands-on opportunity perfect for a detail-obsessed designer who thrives in a fast-moving environment. You won't be building from scratch on day one; instead, you'll focus on formatting, updating, and tailoring existing content to match our proven frameworks while leveraging modern AI tools to streamline your workflow.
What You'll Do

• Format and update presentation materials to seamlessly match Bundle's design templates.

• Build learner-specific versions of existing training materials based on clear guidelines.

• Execute light content edits and regular updates across existing learning assets.

• Conduct quality control, reviewing all materials for design, formatting, and consistency against Bundle's Lesson Plans.

• Apply adult learning principles (andragogy) to keep content clear, actionable, and engaging.

• Utilize modern AI tools (including Claude and Microsoft Copilot) to enhance instructional design efficiency.

• Manage files, resources, and documentation independently using Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint.

What You Bring

• Solid understanding of adult learning principles (andragogy) and how to apply them to professional training.

• Strong presentation design skills (PowerPoint or similar) with a strict eye for visual layout and accessibility standards.

• Hands-on experience actively integrating AI tools-specifically Claude and Microsoft Copilot-into your instructional design workflow.

• Exceptional attention to detail, strong critical thinking, and sound judgment when evaluating content quality.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint).

• High level of autonomy with a proven ability to follow established guidelines and execute independently.

• Clear, professional written communication skills in English.

Desired Requirements

• Background in corporate learning and development (L&D) or higher education instructional design.

• Experience designing skills-based or competency-based corporate training.

Why Join Bundle?

• Flexible, 100% remote work structure

• Opportunity to work directly alongside a collaborative learning design team

• Fast-growing company environment with a validated product and clear trajectory

Are you ready to work for an exceptional state agency that works to protect the life, health, safety, and welfare of the employees in the State of Arizona ? Apply with us! The Industrial Commission of Arizona (ICA) is committed to the highest standards of compliance, demonstrating leadership in all areas, and teaching and working with employers and employees to make them successful. STAFF ATTORNEY
Job Location:

Legal Division

800 W Washington St.

Phoenix, AZ 85007

Salary: $91,300

Grade: 3

Closing Date: Open Until Filled

Job Summary:

The Staff Attorney (Attorney 4) position will provide comprehensive legal representation, advice, and support to the Commission’s members, Director, Deputy Director, and various divisions. Performs legal research, analysis, litigation strategy, and drafting of legal opinions, memoranda, and briefs while representing the Division in statewide legal proceedings and engaging with internal and external stakeholders. This position will focus 25% to 50% of its efforts on collection initiatives, including garnishments, judgment enforcement, and asset investigations, to support agency recovery efforts.

This position may offer the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures.

The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

• Provide legal representation and advice to Commission members, leadership, and divisions by conducting discovery, performing legal research and analysis, developing litigation strategies or legal opinions, and appearing at statewide prehearing conferences, settlement conferences, hearings, trials, mediations, and appellate proceedings.
• Draft and edit legal opinions, memoranda, briefs, and official correspondence while maintaining effective communication with clients, judges, opposing counsel, witnesses, and the public.
• Serve as a Division representative to internal and external customers by participating in committees, delivering presentations and training, and responding to inquiries.
• Maintain electronic files and databases using Industrial Commission of Arizona (ICA) case management systems.
• Support the Legal Unit's adherence to the Arizona Management System (AMS) principles, including using the Huddle Board, reviewing and developing standard work, and participating in cross-training initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):

Knowledge in

• Arizona administrative practices and procedures and personnel rules and requirements.
• The purposes, goals, policies, procedures and practices of the Commission and the Legal Division.
• Legal research methods, legal principles, and their application.
• Arizona law and applicable Federal law as it relates to workers' compensation, OSHA, labor/employment, administrative practice and procedures, appellate practice and procedure, superior court practice and procedure, rulemaking and other regulatory requirements affecting state agencies, contracting and procurement, open meetings, public records, insurance, collection practices and procedures, and bankruptcy/receivership/liquidation.
• Medical terminology, medical diagnoses, and treatment.
• Construction terminology and construction methods.
• Ethical standards applicable to lawyers and public employees.

Skills in

• Legal research and legal writing involving complex questions of law.

title: Member Intake Manager
description:
Job Summary:
The Manager, Member Intake is a hands-on virtual leader responsible for the day-to-day performance, quality, and development of a team of Intake CSRs supporting LegalShield members across all states. This role owns real-time queue management, call quality oversight, coaching, and the professional growth of team members, while driving the team toward defined efficiency, proficiency, and productivity targets.

The Manager is a working leader actively engaged with the live queue, visible and accessible to the team throughout the shift, and directly accountable for delivering a consistent, seamless, and cohesive member experience aligned to the intake framework, disposition standards, and call-flow methodology (Connect → Understand → Assess → Resolve → Close). Responsibilities:
Performance Outcomes
Real-Time Queue & Contact Center Operations

• Monitor live queue activity throughout the shift service level, average speed of answer, calls in queue, agent availability, adherence, and abandoned rate and take immediate action to balance staffing and workload.

• Manage agent status and scheduling exceptions in Workday (WD), including log-in/log-out compliance, breaks, and after-call work.

• Identify and resolve real-time bottlenecks (e.g., callback backlog, referral handling delays, unusually high abandoned rates) before they impact the member experience.

• Escalate systemic issues (telephony, tooling, staffing gaps) with clear data and recommended actions.
Call Listening, QA & Coaching

• Conduct scheduled and ad-hoc live-call monitoring and recorded-call reviews for every direct report on a defined cadence.

• Evaluate calls against the intake call-flow standard (Connect / Understand / Assess / Resolve / Close), verification protocol, OPP procedures, disposition accuracy, and member-experience benchmarks.

• Deliver timely, specific coaching after each observation reinforcing what worked and providing concrete, actionable guidance where the agent can grow.

• Partner with the QA/Trainer to calibrate scoring, close skill gaps identified in QA trends, and ensure coaching is consistent across the team.

• Coach agents on correct use of the Primary + Secondary disposition framework so call data remains reporting-ready for QA, trend analysis, and firm-level insights.
Professional & Personal Development

• Maintain an individual development plan (IDP) for every direct report, updated quarterly, covering role proficiency, career aspirations, and personal growth goals.

• Hold consistent 1:1s that go beyond metrics focusing on the whole person, their engagement, career trajectory, and any barriers to success at work or otherwise.

• Identify high-potential team members and create stretch opportunities (e.g., peer mentorship for new hires, SME ownership of a disposition category, project participation).

• Onboard new hires coming off the training cohort, pairing them with veteran agents and providing intensified coaching support during their first 30/60/90 days.

• Recognize and celebrate wins publicly call saves, member-experience moments, KPI milestones to reinforce a culture of pride and ownership.
KPI Tracking & Performance Management

• Track, analyze, and act on team and individual KPIs, including but not limited to:

• Efficiency: average handle time (AHT), after-call work (ACW), adherence, occupancy, log-in/log-out compliance

• Proficiency: QA score, first-contact resolution, disposition accuracy, verification compliance, adherence to script and call-flow standards

• Productivity: calls handled per shift, intakes opened, callbacks completed, transfer accuracy, referral-handling accuracy

• Member Experience: CSAT / member feedback, escalation rate, complaint rate, save rate on at-risk members

• Build and deliver weekly individual and team performance summaries; identify trends and translate them into targeted coaching actions.

• Own performance management for direct reports from positive recognition through struct

micro1 is engaging Research Scientists in Computer Science & Computational Physics to help advance a customer’s high-impact research project. • Highlight promising new directions and discoveries for deeper exploration by senior research professionals.

• Strong publication track record within the past three years, including multiple top-venue papers and recent results addressing named open problems or introducing novel concepts.

• Hands-on expertise in computational methods, encompassing simulation, numerical analysis, and algorithmic implementation.

• Experience reviewing or sub-reviewing for prominent conferences in your specialty is a plus.

• Background in leveraging frontier models, agents, or formal computational tools (e.g., Lean, SAT/SMT solvers) in scholarly work.

• Publicly shared research statement or homepage outlining specific open problems currently under investigation.

The John Locke Foundation is an independent, nonprofit think tank working for truth, freedom, and the future of North Carolina. Locke envisions a North Carolina in which liberty and limited, constitutional government are the cornerstones of society so that individuals, families, and institutions can freely shape their own destinies. Locke’s mission is to be North Carolina’s most influential force driving public policy so North Carolinians flourish in a free and prosperous society.

Donor stewardship: Execute the delivery of prompt, accurate, and respectful gift acknowledgments via mail, phone, and/or email.
Development research: Identify opportunities to strengthen relationships among Locke's community of existing and prospective donors.
Data management: Maintain accurate records, track interactions and moves management activity, support data hygiene processes, and activity reporting.
HubSpot execution and content creation: Build and schedule emails and workflows, manage lists/segmentation, create and update landing pages and forms as needed, draft and edit basic fundraising and event-related content, and track performance metrics.
 
Qualifications
Currently enrolled in a humanities associate’s, undergraduate, or graduate degree program
Demonstration of prior work experience in an office setting
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Respect for donor privacy and discretion
Ability to learn new software and Artificial Intelligence tools
Commitment to the John Locke Foundation’s principles of free enterprise, individual liberty, and government transparency

Cover letter including: An introductory paragraph(s) describing three distinct reasons you are drawn to John Locke Foundation’s mission and how you came to those beliefs
Resume

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform Integration, Robot Software
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s Robot Software group turns new vehicle programs into stable, reliable robot systems. The Platform Integration team works at the boundary between onboard software and vehicle hardware, bringing up new platforms while building reusable components and frameworks that make every future integration faster and more predictable.

As a Software Engineer on the Platform Integration team, you’ll combine hands-on vehicle and bench work with production software development. Your work will directly enable safe, scalable deployment across multiple vehicle programs.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Support software bring-up on benches, HiL systems, and vehicles, including work at international test locations.

- Develop and maintain vehicle-facing software components and shared frameworks.

- Diagnose integration issues across software and hardware boundaries and drive them through resolution.

- Identify architectural improvements that reduce bespoke work and improve reuse.

- Build diagnostics, tooling, and metrics for robot-software reliability and performance.

- Produce clear documentation and runbooks for long-term supportability.

- Collaborate with hardware, safety, controls, calibration, and reliability teams.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- New vehicle-program bring-up across embedded compute, sensors, networks, and software services.

- Linux-based robotic and automotive systems with multi-process and distributed architectures.

- ROS2 or similar middleware, node development, message interfaces, and system integration.

- Sensor calibration, synchronisation, data validation, and system-level debugging.

- Automotive-grade compute platforms such as NVIDIA DRIVE and Qualcomm Snapdragon Ride.

- Vehicle communication systems including CAN and Automotive Ethernet.

- Shared abstractions and frameworks that improve reliability across programs.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- You have strong software-development experience in C++, Python, or Rust.

- You have delivered production-quality software on Linux-based robotic, embedded, or automotive platforms.

- You understand ROS2 or similar robotics middleware and distributed-system integration.

- You have hands-on experience integrating software with vehicle or embedded hardware.

- You can diagnose complex problems using logs, telemetry, on-target tests, and systematic experimentation.

- You understand vehicle sensors, networking, and the practical realities of platform bring-up.

Experience with drive-by-wire systems, CAN tools, shared frameworks, HiL or simulation, functional safety, technical documentation, or observability would be valuable.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalize and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve

Further information is available at www.paysafe.com.

Position to work remotely, based in Brazil.
Important: CV must be attached in English.

Role Summary
The Accounting Specialist - Regulatory supports the regulatory accounting and financial reporting obligations of Paysafe 's regulated Payment Institution in Brazil. Reporting to the Brazil Controller, the role owns COSIF bookkeeping, expected credit loss calculations, Pix and payment account reconciliations, and the preparation and submission of ancillary obligations to the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB). It ensures accurate and timely regulatory submissions, effective financial controls, complete supporting evidence, and readiness for audits and regulatory inspections, working closely with Accounting, Finance, Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, Risk, Treasury, Tax, Internal Audit, and external auditors.

Responsibilities

• Perform the daily and monthly bookkeeping of the Payment Institution in accordance with the COSIF chart of accounts and National Financial System accounting standards.

• Classify and measure the institution's financial instruments (amortized cost, fair value through other comprehensive income, and fair value through profit or loss).

• Calculate and record the provision for expected losses (Expected Credit Loss model, Stages 1, 2 and 3) on customer receivables, operating balances, and financial assets, in line with CMN Resolution No. 4,966/2021 and IFRS 9.

• Prepare, validate, and transmit ancillary obligations to the BCB, especially CADOC 4010/4016, 9010/9011, and 4111, as well as information on payment accounts and electronic money balances.

• Perform daily settlement reconciliation for Pix and payment accounts, comparing transactional platform reports with COSIF balances, and identify and correct discrepancies.

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Per diem employees qualify for:

• Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

title: Software Engineer, Storage Systems (Agent Infra)
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

Storage decides how fast agent sandboxes start and how safely they share data. Agents need a filesystem that thousands of sandboxes mount at the same time, with strict isolation and the consistency agents need. Agent context is mostly small files, so the access patterns look very different from storage built for large files.

The Agent Infra team builds Agent Drive, the distributed filesystem that agent sandboxes mount over FUSE, and the storage underneath it. The work uses tiered caching, replication, content-addressed data, and Linux filesystem internals. In September 2026, Baseten acquired Blaxel https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/, whose sandboxes and Agent Drive filesystem are the foundation for Baseten Sandboxes https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes.

We are building a cloud, not just using one, so storage is designed for many tenants from day one. The team is small and ownership is big: we ship in weeks and months, not multi-year programs.

If you care about page cache coherency, FUSE, replication protocols, and content-addressable storage, we'd love to talk.

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

- Blaxel is joining Baseten to build the future of agentic infrastructure https://www.baseten.co/blog/blaxel-is-joining-baseten-to-build-the-future-of-agentic-cloud/

- Baseten Sandboxes documentation https://docs.baseten.co/sandboxes

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and implement core Agent Drive features: metadata replication, volume placement, garbage collection, and FUSE client behavior

- Solve multi-attach correctness: cache coherency across many FUSE mounts of the same drive, dentry and inode invalidation, write ordering, and crash consistency

- Optimize tail latency on read and write paths, including page cache strategy, writeback, prefetch, and metadata RPC batching

- Build tenant isolation into the storage layer, including quota enforcement, blast-radius containment, and noisy-neighbor mitigation

- Own the storage side of sandbox startup and resume performance

- Build durable block storage for sandboxes alongside other Baseten storage teams

- Build observability into every layer, drive storage incidents end to end, and turn each one into a permanent fix

- Contribute upstream to the open-source storage projects we build on

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong systems programming background in Go, Rust, and/or C/C++, with comfort reading kernel code

- Deep understanding of Linux filesystem and storage internals: VFS, page cache, dentry and inode caches, FUSE, the block I/O stack, fsync semantics, and crash consistency

- Hands-on experience building distributed storage systems, content-addressable storage, or large-scale caching infrastructure

- Experience profiling I/O, memory, and RPC bottlenecks and optimizing tail latency in production

- Ability to debug correctness bugs that only show up under concurrency or partial failure

- You move fast and like owning a problem end to end on a small team

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with a distributed filesystem or object store such as JuiceFS, CephFS, or S3-compatible storage, or contributions to those projects

- Knowledge of consensus and replication protocols (Raft, leader leases, quorum reads)

- Experience with snapshot, clone, and copy-on-write filesystem features

- Experience operating multi-tenant storage with hard isolation requirem

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We’re looking for an Enterprise Solutions Engineer to own the technical win on Middesk’s largest and most complex opportunities: banks, large fintechs, payment platforms, lenders, and other regulated institutions where business verification sits in the critical path of onboarding, underwriting, or ongoing risk management.

Reporting to the Director of Solutions Engineering, this is a highly visible role in a high-growth, execution-driven environment. title: Plant Controller Project Lead
description:
Leidos Engineering has an opportunity for an experienced Project Lead to direct the engineering design of a high-profile plant controller and plant-wide SCADA program for a large behind-the-meter hybrid energy facility in the ERCOT market. The facility combines utility-scale wind and solar generation with a mission-critical AI data center load, connected to the grid through dual 345 kV points of interconnection.

The Project Lead will work alongside the Project Manager and program leadership within Leidos Energy. You will be the technical owner of the design: directing a multidisciplinary team of controls, SCADA/HMI, OT cybersecurity, and power systems studies engineers and specialty subcontractors, integrating their work into a coordinated design, and serving as the lead technical voice to the EPC client, equipment vendors, and the owner’s engineers from detailed design through commissioning.

About the Project:
The site-level plant controller is the real-time orchestration layer for the facility, issuing validated setpoints, constraints, and priorities to downstream asset controllers while respecting vendor-certified control logic. Its objectives are to:

• Define and enforce a reliable, predictable operating envelope for the mission-critical data center load

• Dispatch wind and solar generation to regulate voltage, frequency, and apparent power at the dual points of interconnection in line with ERCOT and interconnection requirements

• Coordinate with wind and solar power plant controllers, capacitor banks, and transformer tap changers to regulate the POI and protect equipment ratings

• Maximize use of on-site renewable generation and minimize unnecessary curtailment

• Report key performance indicators for the POI, generation, and load assets through SCADA, HMI, and historian systems

• Provide a secure, NERC CIP-ready architecture that can integrate future battery storage and natural gas generation without redesign

This is a permanent, salaried position with Leidos . While this role will focus on one particular project, there is no projected end date for this position, and the selected individual can expect to take part in ongoing Leidos projects in the future. The salary pay range for this postion is between 175 - 225k USD, depending on the selected candidate's experience and qualifications.

As a Leidos employee, you can look forward to a fast-paced, diverse work environment and flexible work hours/work arrangements, as well as managers who will encourage career development and growth opportunities, including:

• Professional Engineer (PE) licensure and Project Management Professional (PMP) certification support

• Formal Mentorship programs

• Learning & Development Resources

• Continuing Education Programs

• Technical leadership tracks and project management opportunities

In this role, you can expect to:

• Serve as technical owner of the plant control and SCADA design across the project lifecycle, from requirements and concept of operations through detailed design, testing, commissioning, and closeout

• Direct engineering leads for controls, SCADA/HMI, OT networking and cybersecurity, and power systems studies, integrating their work into one coordinated design

• Develop requirements, use cases, control narratives, and control algorithms for plant-level functions such as voltage and reactive power regulation, frequency response, POI and equipment limit control, and load coordination

• Apply power system modeling and study results to define control limits, operating envelopes, and equipment sizing

• Develop and manage interface specifications with third-party controllers, OEMs, utilities, and other stakeholders, and resolve technical conflicts between parties

• Ensure the design supports grid operator interconnection requirements and applicable NERC standards

title: Software Engineer, ERP Applications & Development
description:

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Job

ERP Technology builds and runs the custom applications and integrations that keep Anduril's Finance, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing operations moving at the pace that our mission demands. Our Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP platform is the backbone of those operations, but standard ERP functionality doesn't cover everything the business needs. That gap is where this role lives.

As a Software Engineer on ERP Technology, you will design, build, and maintain the internal tools, backend services, and APIs that extend what Fusion can do out of the box. You'll work alongside ERP product teams spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Accounting, Manufacturing, and more, and across the systems the ERP ecosystem touches, including Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), enterprise data platforms, and the business applications those teams depend on. Your job is to turn ambiguous requirements into software that holds up in production, not just in a demo.

• Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain custom applications, internal tools, and backend services supporting the ERP ecosystem.

• Partner with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) developers to keep new applications compatible with established integration architecture, and support design and testing of solutions touching financial, supply chain, procurement, and manufacturing systems.

• Implement authentication, authorization, error handling, logging, and monitoring that meets production standards.

• Identify opportunities to replace manual work with solutions and automation, including tools for data validation, reconciliation, workflow orchestration, and operational reporting.

• Own ongoing engineering support and reliability for applications in your portfolio: diagnose defects, build automated testing and monitoring, and maintain technical documentation and runbooks.

• Partner with ERP technical and functional teams, Product Managers, Enterprise Architecture, OIC developers, ERP administrators, and Security to deliver end-to-end solutions that meet real operational needs.

• Participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, and continuous improvement of how the team builds and ships software.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of professional software development experience.

• Strong programming skills in one or more of: Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

• Experience building standalone applications, backend services, internal tools, or enterprise software.

• Experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and working with JSON, XML, and related data formats.

• Experience with SQL, relational databases, and data processing.

• Working familiarity with modern development frameworks, Git, CI/CD pipelin
